name: Repanse de Lyonesse
canonNotes: A humble shepherdess of Lyonesse who, at the Lady's call, took up a slain knight's armour and led Bretonnia's shamed knights against Chaos.
Leads an errantry war to the south in the Lady's name.
voiceNotes: Earnest, devout and brave; humble yet unshakable.
Inspires others; no tolerance for cowardice or heresy.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
